title: Connect Factors and Zeros
student_objective: I can explain and use the relationship among linear factors, zeros, solutions, and x-intercepts of a quadratic function.
teacher_objective: Diagnose same-sign factor/zero errors, failure to use the zero-product property, confusion among factors, zeros, and intercepts, missed common factors, repeated-zero errors, and unsupported graph connections.

concept_cards.title: A zero makes a factor zero
concept_cards.content: If x-r is a factor, then x=r makes that factor equal 0. Therefore r is a zero of the function.

concept_cards.title: Use the zero-product property
concept_cards.content: When a product equals 0, at least one factor must equal 0. Set each linear factor equal to 0 and solve.

concept_cards.title: Connect four representations
concept_cards.content: The factor x-r, solution x=r, zero r, and x-intercept (r,0) describe the same location in different ways.

concept_cards.title: Factor completely first
concept_cards.content: A common monomial factor may reveal an additional zero. For example, x(x-5)=0 has zeros 0 and 5.

concept_cards.title: Repeated factors create repeated zeros
concept_cards.content: The factor (x-r)^2 gives a repeated zero r. Its graph typically touches the x-axis at (r,0) instead of crossing.

items.prompt: If x-6 is a factor, what zero does it produce?
items.tutor_behavior: Set x-6 equal to zero and solve.
Set each factor equal to zero.

items.prompt: A function has zero 3. Write its corresponding x-intercept.
items.tutor_behavior: A zero is an x-value; the graph point has y=0.

items.prompt: Find the zeros of f(x)=(x-4)(x+1).

solution_steps.explanation: Set the first factor equal to zero.
Set the second factor equal to zero.

items.tutor_behavior: Verify that each value makes the product zero.

items.prompt: Factor x^2-7x+12 and identify its zeros.

solution_steps.explanation: Find numbers with the needed sum and product.
Set each factor equal to zero.

items.tutor_behavior: Connect factor constants to opposite-sign zeros.

items.prompt: Find all zeros of f(x)=2x^2-8x.

solution_steps.explanation: Factor out the greatest common factor.

items.tutor_behavior: Do not lose the zero created by the x factor.

items.prompt: If x+7 is a factor, identify the zero and x-intercept.
items.tutor_behavior: Solve x+7=0, then write the graph point.

items.prompt: Solve x(x+5)=0.
items.tutor_behavior: Treat x as a factor that can equal zero.

items.prompt: The factors are (x-2)^2. Identify the zero and its multiplicity.
items.tutor_behavior: The same factor appears twice.

items.prompt: Find the zeros of f(x)=(x+4)(x-9).
items.tutor_behavior: Set each factor equal to zero.

items.prompt: Factor x^2+x-12 and identify the zeros.
items.tutor_behavior: Use numbers 4 and -3, then reverse signs for the zeros.

items.prompt: Find all zeros of 3x^2+12x.
items.tutor_behavior: Factor as 3x(x+4).

items.prompt: A graph touches the x-axis at (5,0) and has no other x-intercept. Write a possible pair of linear factors.
items.tutor_behavior: A touch at one intercept indicates a repeated factor in this context.

items.prompt: Find the zeros of y=(x-8)(x+3).
items.tutor_behavior: Solve each factor equation.

items.prompt: Factor x^2-2x-15 and identify its zeros.
items.tutor_behavior: Use factors -5 and 3, then apply the zero-product property.

items.prompt: Find all zeros of 4x^2-20x.
items.tutor_behavior: Factor as 4x(x-5).

items.prompt: A quadratic has x-intercepts (-2,0) and (6,0). Write its linear factors without a scale factor.
items.tutor_behavior: Translate each intercept x-value into an opposite-sign factor.

items.prompt: A student says x+4 is a factor, so 4 is a zero. Write the correct zero.
items.explanation_prompt: Explain why the zero has the opposite sign.
items.explanation_guidance: Set the factor x+4 equal to zero; solving gives x=-4.
items.tutor_behavior: Require the factor equation and its solution.

items.prompt: If x-1 is a factor, what is the corresponding x-intercept?
items.tutor_behavior: Solve x-1=0 and write the point.

items.prompt: Which factor corresponds to the zero -6?
items.tutor_behavior: Use x-r with r=-6.
Solve 2x-6=0 and x+1=0 separately.

items.prompt: Identify the zero of the factor 3x+12.
items.tutor_behavior: Solve 3x+12=0.

items.prompt: Factor x^2-10x+25 and identify the zero and multiplicity.
items.tutor_behavior: Recognize a perfect-square trinomial.

items.prompt: Does x=2 make (x-2)(x+7) equal zero? Answer yes or no.
items.tutor_behavior: Substitute x=2 and observe the first factor.

items.prompt: Find all zeros of 2x^2+6x-20.
items.tutor_behavior: Factor 2(x+5)(x-2), then solve.

items.prompt: If neither factor in a product is zero, can the product be zero? Answer yes or no.
items.tutor_behavior: State the zero-product property.

items.prompt: A graph crosses at (-3,0) and touches at (2,0). Write possible factors showing multiplicity.
items.tutor_behavior: Use one factor for the crossing and a repeated factor for the touch.

items.prompt: A student solves x(x-4)=0 and reports only x=4. What zero was missed?
items.tutor_behavior: The factor x itself equals zero when x=0.

items.prompt: A height model is h(t)=-5t(t-4). At what times is the height zero?
items.tutor_behavior: Set each time factor equal to zero.

items.prompt: Complete the link: factor x-9, zero ___, x-intercept ___.
items.tutor_behavior: Solve the factor equation, then write the graph point.

factor_zero_sign.teacher_signal: Uses the factor constant with the same sign as the zero

zero_product_property.teacher_signal: Does not set every factor equal to zero

zero_intercept_connection.teacher_signal: Confuses a zero value with an x-intercept point

factoring_to_zeros.teacher_signal: Cannot connect complete factorization to zeros

common_factor.teacher_signal: Loses the zero created by a common x factor

repeated_zero.teacher_signal: Does not recognize multiplicity from a repeated factor

graph_factor_connection.teacher_signal: Cannot translate x-intercepts or touch/cross behavior into factors

nonmonic_factor.teacher_signal: Cannot solve a nonmonic linear factor for its zero

verify_zero.teacher_signal: Cannot verify that a zero makes the function equal zero

context_zeros.teacher_signal: Cannot interpret contextual zeros from factors
